_: Genres & moods per title, keyed mediaType:tmdbId. `source` says where a title's subgenres and moods came from, `primaryGenreSource` where its primary genre and `animated` came from. Seeded by scripts/v2/seed_genres_moods_curated.py (oxyc/den-dataset#56).

sources.classify-swap: Derived from the classify pass (combined-v1-r2): every subgenre/theme and mood Noul >= 0.8, strongest first, top 3 per field, the Noul as the confidence (#56).
sources.july-relabel: The July relabel: Claude Code subagents (Opus on the most-voted titles, Sonnet on the rest), one pass, assembled at 0.55 subgenre / 0.50 theme / 0.55 mood, top 3.
sources.september-subagents: The September labelling phase (scripts/v2/merge_classify_labels.py): Claude subagents, 0.5 floor, top 3. Only its primary genres and `animated` are kept.
